title: Ikenai Mousou Fudanshi
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Satou secretly reads boys' love manga and daydreams about men, but tells himself it is only a hobby because he has a girlfriend. When he ends up sharing a home with Arihara, a handyman who matches his ideal type, his fantasies grow until he admits he has real feelings. The volume also includes a short romance between a glasses-wearing librarian and a flashy high school boy (AniList and MangaUpdates blurb).
life_message: Admitting who you are drawn to, rather than hiding it behind a hobby, is shown as the way to happiness.

content.note: Blurb speaks of 'indecent' fantasies; MU lists Masturbation, Wet Dreams, Anilingus, Sex Friend/s; MangaDex rating erotica.

folkways.japan: Fudanshi (male BL fans) is a recognised Japanese fandom niche, and keeping a hobby private to avoid embarrassment reflects common Japanese norms of discretion.
